1065.description: The bid FX Swap points for an FX Swap. It is the "far bid forward points - near offer forward point". Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

1066.name: OfferSwapPoints
1066.description: The offer FX Swap points for an FX Swap. It is the "far offer forward points - near bid forward points". Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

1067.name: LegBidForwardPoints
1067.description: The bid FX forward points for the leg of an FX Swap. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

1068.name: LegOfferForwardPoints
1068.description: The offer FX forward points for the leg of an FX Swap. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

1069.name: SwapPoints
1069.description: For FX Swap, this is used to express the differential between the far leg's bid/offer and the near leg's bid/offer. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

1071.name: LastSwapPoints
1071.description: For FX Swap, this is used to express the last market event for the differential between the far leg's bid/offer and the near leg's bid/offer in a fill or partial fill. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

1072.name: SideGrossTradeAmt

1073.name: LegLastForwardPoints
1073.description: The forward points for this leg's fill event. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

1074.name: LegCalculatedCcyLastQty
1074.description: Used for the calculated quantity of the other side of the currency for this leg. Can be derived from LegQty and LegLastPx.

1075.name: LegGrossTradeAmt
1075.description: The gross trade amount of the leg. For FX Futures this is used to express the notional value of a fill when LegLastQty and other quantity fields are express in terms of contract size.
